versions.changelog:
Initial release. Diagnose structure and logical move ordering of Discussion sections in psychology research papers.

- Checks for presence and quality of key Discussion "moves" (results, literature, applications, limitations, future work, contribution, opening move)
- Assesses logical ordering and alignment with Introduction sections
- Flags common narrative and rhetorical weaknesses in move coverage, order, or symmetry
- Does not generate or rewrite prose—diagnosis and suggestions only
- Structured, actionable output for easy feedback
